Eggers, Andrew C. and Alexander Coppock. 2026. <b>What do we learn from registered reports?</b>. Submitted to the Journal of Politics}.


# Abstract
In a registered report, the researcher submits a research design for review and the journal decides whether to publish the completed study before results are available. We use a formal model of the publication process to assess how registered reports affect learning when journal space is scarce.
